title: Recover after a failed bash call and verify the retry
summary: One DSH episode recorded a failed bash result followed by a later successful bash result in the same Model × Harness configuration. The exact corrective intervention was not captured.
intendedUseSummary: Guide human-reviewed recovery after a failed bash call.
Preserve the failure signal, make an explicit corrective change, and verify the acceptance condition.
outOfScopeSummary: Automatic retries without checking side-effect and permission risk.
Claims that the recipe caused success or generalizes to another Model or Harness configuration.
knownFailureSummary: Repeating the same call without changing the failed condition.
Treating a later successful call as proof of causality.
Applying the pattern to destructive or non-idempotent operations without review.
positiveCaseSummary: The later bash result carried no recorded tool error.
negativeCaseSummary: The task had not yet reached the recovery acceptance boundary.
scoreExplanation: Local SQLite FTS match over title, summary, task, recipe, and cases.
Negative/boundary evidence was retained in ranking.
